title: Turn right instead
prompt: Draw the same square as before, sides of 40, but turning right at each corner.
hints: turn_right does the same as turn_left, the other way.

docs.name: move_forward(distance)
docs.what: Drives the turtle forward that many pixels, drawing a line. Takes one number; returns nothing.

docs.name: turn_right()
docs.what: Turns the turtle 90 degrees to the right. Give it a number to turn by a different angle.

solution:
func run():
	move_forward(40)
	turn_right()
	move_forward(40)
	turn_right()
	move_forward(40)
	turn_right()
	move_forward(40)
	turn_right()
